lean.statement: theorem exists_picardUniversalRankMatchLocus_core_rank {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [Flat f] [IsProper f] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f] (hO : ∀ {T : Scheme.{u}} (g : T ⟶ S), IsIso ((Classical.choose (Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction (pullback.snd f g))).unit.app (SheafOfModules.unit T.ringCatSheaf))) (E : X.Modules) [E.IsFiniteLocallyFree] : ∃ (W : Scheme.{u}) (j : W ⟶ S), IsImmersion j ∧ ∀ {T : Scheme.{u}} (g : T ⟶ S), (∃ h : T ⟶ W, h ≫ j = g) ↔ PicardUniversalRankMatchCoreCondition f E g

statement: There exist W and j such that j is an immersion and factorization through j is equivalent to PicardUniversalRankMatchCoreCondition.
